title: Security level management
description: Manage security level catalog and per-level configuration.

config.title: Security config: {{name}}
config.successWithCascade: Saved. Higher levels that have not been customized will inherit this change
config.cascadeWarning: Higher levels that have not been customized will inherit permissions/flags from this level. Levels with their own saved config are not affected. Level passwords are not inherited.
config.watermarkRequiresDownload: Enable Download documents before enabling Watermark.
config.downloadDependentsRequireDownload: Enable Download documents before enabling Watermark or ZIP encryption.

password.label: Dossier password
password.placeholder: Enter new password (leave blank to keep)
password.requiredHint: Require dossier password is on — a dossier password must exist before saving.
password.hasPassword: This level already has a dossier password.
password.currentRequired: Current dossier password is required to change or clear it.

filePassword.label: File password
filePassword.placeholder: Enter new file password (leave blank to keep)
filePassword.requiredHint: Require file password is on — a file password must exist before saving.
filePassword.hasPassword: This level already has a file password.
filePassword.mismatch: File password confirmation does not match.
filePassword.currentRequired: Current file password is required to change or clear it.

permissions.title: Permission catalog
permissions.description: CRUD permissions shown in level config. New permissions default to off on all levels.

key.label: Permission key
key.hint: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore. Immutable after create.

delete.confirmDescription: Delete "{{name}}"? System permissions cannot be deleted. Level rules for this key will be removed.

access.levelDescription: Files at this level require a password before viewing or downloading.
access.dossierDescription: This dossier requires a password before viewing or downloading.
access.fileDescription: This file requires its own password. Unlocking one file does not unlock another.

delete.confirmDescription: Delete "{{name}}"? Blocked if dossiers still use this level.
